bio: The restaurant of Almfamilyhotel Scherer, which is right at the foot of the ski slope, ticks a lot of boxes: cheerful, modern Alpine decor, attentive service and, above all, delicious food that showcases carefully selected seasonal produce. You don't have to be a hotel guest to fall in love with delicious dishes served here, such as braised piglet cheeks with creamed parsnips, crispy apricot and rosemary dumplings, and asparagus. Lunch and dinner can be ordered à la carte. Additionally, you have the option to pre-order the surprise menu for the evening – named THE TASTE, it comprises at least 12 creative and mostly regionally inspired courses, and the value for money is excellent....
